invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of HoodieJavaTable.create, which should be non-null under normal operation.
config is passed into multiple parameters and used in building metaClient and HoodieJavaTable, so must be non-null.
context is dereferenced (.getStorageConf()), so must be non-null.
The result is exactly the value returned by HoodieJavaTable.create(config, context, metaClient) as per the code.
Method is declared to return HoodieJavaTable<T>, so result should have this type.
